data.hypothesis: A scalar argmin has a loop-carried comparison and index dependency for every element. Tracking signed minima and their earliest indices per AVX-512 lane processes 16 values per vector while retaining the first-index tie rule. A scalar fallback handles short inputs and a scalar tail completes non-multiple-of-16 sizes; the target attribute requests AVX-512F locally for the supplied EPYC 9654 target.
data.notes: The supplied baseline is valid and correct, with repeated times 4.465990, 4.461839 and 4.461889 microseconds (mean 4.463240 microseconds). No candidate timing or correctness result is available yet; the controller must evaluate both.
transformations: Maintain a signed minimum and corresponding earliest absolute index in each of 16 AVX-512 lanes across complete vectors.
Update lane minima and indices only when a strictly smaller value arrives, preserving earlier equal minima; compare lane results by value then index.
Use a scalar path below one full vector and a scalar tuple comparison for the remaining tail.
